answer: Travel agents offering a karst cave tour, a garden visit or a pearl workshop should publish listings backed by venue-signed capacity tokens. Each token names a venue, time and seat; the marketplace permits one active listing per token across all agent keys and checks revocation before booking. Aliases cannot turn one seat into a thousand offers. Flooding the market requires renting additional real seats and bearing their reservation costs. Venue enrollment must be checked independently, since a fake venue could otherwise mint unlimited tokens.
